title: Description and Part Number cannot be left empty when editing
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-EDITREQ-01), with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Edit Required), is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Clear the Description completely.
  4. Clear the Part Number completely.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: "Description is a required field" shows under Description and "Part number is a required field" under Part Number. The part is not saved.
  • Step 6: the window closes.
  • Step 7: the fields still read {Description-A} and {Part-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-N2, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (Save with nothing filled), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-N2: “An empty Description shows "Description is a required field" and an empty Part Number shows "Part number is a required field". The part is not saved.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Description field empty or only spaces): “"Description is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part Number field empty or only spaces): “"Part number is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
